title: chore(skills): delete the published objectstack-pm-dispatch skill and retire every reference that pinned it
body:
Fixes #17311

## 裁决 — the maintainer's words, verbatim and untranslated (chat, 2026-09-10)

- The question, 03:1xZ: 「对外发布的 skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/SKILL.md 这个很老了，和现在的也完全不一致吧？是否建议删除。」
- The ruling, 05:3xZ: 「发布版 skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch 删」

This is 删已发布能力 on the manual floor, ruled in those words. It REVERSES the 2026-09-03 batch-3 ruling, item 4 option B, which narrowed the decision-frame COPIES to two and kept the published copy — `scripts/check-skill-frame-sync.mjs:2–:4` on `origin/main` read 「exists as TWO hand-written copies across two files (#5798, narrowed to two by the 2026-09-03 batch-3 ruling, item 4 option B — see COPIES below)」. The newer ruling wins: the published copy leaves with its file, and COPIES holds the internal copy alone.

Governed surface (`skills/**` and `scripts/pm/**`): draft PR, human merge only — never ready, queued, auto-merged or approved by a seat. Dispatched by the skills seat, session `session_01MoTv7pn338AZ71owsp19gQ` (GitHub `os-justin`), `mode:subagent`, built at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (clause ①: the surface edits `MANDATORY_TIER_GLOBS`).

## Every reference in the card — before → after

Measured on `origin/main` at `8c9bd8f5`; landed at `7f9ff5ae3` (16 files, +263 / −1126).

Item 12, the tree-wide grep after the edits (`git grep -n 'objectstack-pm-dispatch\|PM Dispatch'`, excluding `content/docs/releases/`): zero hits under `.claude/**` (none existed at the base either), zero in docs, apps, templates and fixtures. Every remaining hit is justified: the frame-sync header and COPIES docblock (the ruling and the history), its new anti-dormancy case that plants a frame at the deleted path on purpose, the token-ratchet note where the row was, the dispatch-gates docblock sentence and self-test case that pin the entry's absence, and one comment in the create-objectstack test explaining the count. The compatibility gate's header mentions "the published PM skill" by description, not by path.

## The one-copy reading for the two frame gates

`check:skill-frame-sync` — measured with a one-entry COPIES, `runAllChecks` still judges: the copy's own coherence (declared count = written entries; declaring and binding sentences agree; every axis resolves through AXIS_MAP; no axis twice; every in-file count mention agrees) and the anti-dormancy scan (74 markdown files under `.claude/` and `skills/`, the declared file excluded, read for a fingerprint of the frame). The cross-copy isomorphism (the counts set, the sequence set) has one member and cannot fire. That half is DISCHARGED, not weakened: the maintainer removed its whole comparison population, and the code re-arms untouched the moment a second COPIES entry is declared. The gate stays wired; its header and pass line now say exactly which half ran. What a single copy loses in-tree is axis ORDER — it was only ever judged copy against copy — and `check:skill-frame-freshness` judges the sole copy's count and sequence against `origin/main` instead.

Its self-test went from 13 to 14 cases. Four cases lost their subject with the pair (cross-copy count; the English "both axes" quantifier; cross-copy reorder; the zh-pattern swap that reddened only through cross-copy disagreement). They are replaced by single-copy checks that had no pin before — the declaring/binding self-contradiction, a duplicate axis, AXIS_MAP losing a spelling — plus one discharge pin (a coherent three-axis rewrite of the sole copy stays GREEN, recorded so that a PR declaring a second copy has to flip it) and one new anti-dormancy regression pin: a frame reappearing at `skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` is red. Three `published-pm` cases were re-pointed at `internal-pm` (the binding sentence removed; the declaring sentence removed; a count-mention drift, injected beside the binding sentence because the internal copy's only mention IS its declaring sentence). Roster and floor moved 13 → 14.

`check:skill-frame-freshness` (assumption A) — the gate's arithmetic tolerates one copy: `SAMPLE_COPY_ID`, `SAMPLE_FRAME_FILE` and `FRAME_FILES` are all derived from COPIES, and the two-axis specimen is manufactured per copy. One self-test fixture did not tolerate it: case 7 ("a framework file exists here but not on the ref") built its ref side as every frame file except the sample — an EMPTY set with one copy — and git cannot commit an empty tree, so `refSha` read as an empty string and the case judged against nothing. Measured before the fix: "✗ a framework file exists here but not on the ref → WARN, both readings stated — expected warn, got ok". Fixed inside the gate's own self-test contract (a sentinel non-frame file on the ref side, and a guard that throws if the ref commit did not land); the verdict code is untouched. Not a bypass.

## Reverse verification — the reds measured before each repair

- Token ratchet on the bare deletion: "✗ check-skills-token-ratchet: cannot read skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/SKILL.md — red, not a skip (#4690)" (and the same for `rules/dev-template.md`); "2 of 46 published bundle file(s) failed their check". A pinned path that no longer exists is a red read, not a "ceilings down" notice — assumption B below.
- Compatibility gate on the bare deletion: "stale exemption: skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/SKILL.md is on the exemption list but was not found."
- Liveness gate on the bare deletion: "[stale-exemption] 3 ledger entries are no longer reached by the scan … run with --update to prune the ledger and commit it."
- Frame-sync on the bare deletion: ENOENT thrown from `readCopies()` reading the deleted file — red by crash, not by skip.
- Freshness self-test with one copy and the old fixture: "expected warn, got ok" (above).
- Token-ratchet self-test with the literal pin: "✗ every SKILL.md still carries its own ceiling (got 10, want 11)".
- create-objectstack with a ten-name list and the old assertion: "AssertionError: .claude/skills/ must appear as its own line: expected undefined to be truthy" — the ten-link farm sits exactly at `COLLAPSE_AT` and enumerates (a directory collapses only above the threshold).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** 按你 2026-09-10 的裁决,删掉对外发布的 `skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch` 技能(SKILL.md 与 rules/dev-template.md 两个文件),并把仓库里所有钉着它的地方一起收掉:技能目录索引与文档页(由生成器重生成)、决策框架同步门禁里的发布拷贝条目、派发工具的强制档位表条目、两条 token 棘轮上限、兼容性豁免与其夹具、若干门禁自测夹具、活性台账里的三条豁免、脚手架测试的期望清单。`.claude/**` 一字未动。

**为什么改。** 这份发布版是内部 PM 协议的一份三态旧拷贝(只认 pm:queue / pm:dispatched / needs-user-decision),和今天的协议已完全对不上,却随每个 `npm create objectstack` 装进客户项目;已知消费者为零。留着它等于向客户 AI 分发一套过时的流程。这一裁决推翻了 2026-09-03 第三批第 4 项选 B 的决定(当时把决策框架拷贝收窄到两份并保留发布版);以新裁决为准。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 已装过该技能的项目不会被动删除,只是以后不再装;仓库里没有代码引用它。决策框架的「跨拷贝同构比较」因为只剩一份拷贝而自然失效——这是比较对象被裁掉,不是门禁被削弱;单份拷贝的自洽检查与「防止拷贝悄悄回来」的扫描照常运行,并新增一条回归钉:该路径若再出现决策框架即红。回滚 = revert 本 PR 一个提交即可,所有变更都在同一提交链上,无数据迁移。

**席位意见。**

**你要做的。** 确认上述读法(尤其「同构比较已卸责」这一条),然后人工合并。本 PR 已挂 `skip-changeset`:没有任何 npm 包的发布内容移动(证据见下)。

### PM mechanism assumptions A–F, measured

- A (one-copy COPIES): the freshness arithmetic tolerates one copy; only its case-7 fixture hard-coded a pair by construction (empty ref side). Fixed in the gate's own self-test; stated above.
- B (token ratchet): removing a pinned file does not lower the total by itself — the ratchet reds on the dead row ("cannot read … red, not a skip"), so the rows must go with the files. After that, the price tag reads ceilings down by 11,546 in the shrink-only direction, no ruling needed.
- C (docs generator): `packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-docs.ts`, wired as `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:skill-docs` / `check:skill-docs` (filter-scoped, not a root script); `check:skill-docs` is in the derived list and is green. It also rewrites the README's generated block, which is how the catalog row left.
- D (create-objectstack): `skills-install.ts` installs with `--skill '*' --agent claude-code` and enumerates no name; the only list is the test's literal expectation, so only the test changed. Built through the verify lock and grepped: `dist/` has 0 hits for `objectstack-pm-dispatch` against 3 hits for the positive control `objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills`, and the test's bytes are not in `dist/`. One wrinkle: the ten-link `.claude/skills/` farm sits exactly at `COLLAPSE_AT` and enumerates, so the "counts symlinks without following them" case now reads the property off the ten symlink lines (lstat size = the target path string, never the pointed-to tree) and asserts the threshold assumption explicitly. No changeset owed.
- E (#14290, `Restart-touch: scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`): this diff touches only the `MANDATORY_TIER_GLOBS` table (one entry removed), one docblock sentence, and the self-test (one case removed, two added, one path swapped). Nothing in how dispatch-gates resolves gates, populations or hints moved; the self-test's 1639 cases pass. Named here, not folded.
